messages:
Aria Chen: incident-bot triggered pager: high error-rate on /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1. 5xx spike from 03:12:00 to 03:16:00, ~18% error rate.
incident-bot: Alert: PROD /v1/generate — error_rate >= 15% — page created (pager#3421). See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serve-errors
Diego Morales: I'm on it, jumping to the bridge. collecting logs + tailing ingress.
Samir Patel: taking postmortem owner if this turns into a sev. I'll keep tracking customer impact. Priya please triage customer-facing callbacks.
Priya Kapoor: ACK. I see elevated timeouts and a handful of internal exceptions: `kv_cache_full` in the runtime logs. Paging dedicated nodes for shard 7.
Maya Alvarez: Oncall handoff in 18m — if this is active after 03:30, handoff will need full context. Please include mitigation steps in the thread.
Diego Morales: Quick mitigation: disable long-context batching on shard 7 and restart the worker pool. Command I ran:
```bash
ssh gpu-7
sudo systemctl restart redwood-infer-worker --node=shard-7
# monitoring: curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep error_rate
```
Samir Patel: after restart error_rate dropped to 1.6% on shard 7. Good. But we saw a replay of requests to older model version causing KV cache growth.
Aria Chen: root cause hypothesis: background compaction process stalled, causing cache fill and OOM-ish failures. Need to confirm with logs. Samir can you grab gc/compaction logs from 02:50-03:20?
Samir Patel: pulling logs now. Found compaction loop errors: `compaction_task failed: timeout waiting for lock (200ms)` repeated. Also operator configs show compaction_interval set to `1s` on shard-7 — that seems suspiciously aggressive.
Priya Kapoor: Customer impact: we saw 4 customers with degraded throughput (two - high SLA risk). Contacted AE for customer A (internal ticket INC-9876). No PII exposed.
Maya Alvarez: For the handoff: I'm taking the bridge at 03:30. @Aria please paste what replay steps you want captured; @Samir attach logs + slo graphs.
Aria Chen: Action items while oncall: 1) revert compaction_interval to 60s on shard-7 (cfg id: cfg-shard7-2024) 2) add temporary circuit-breaker to route heavy-context requests to fallback model variant 3) schedule postmortem and notify CS.
Diego Morales: I put a hotfix: updated cfg-shard7-2024 compaction_interval => 60s and rolled to shard7 nodes. Commands:
```yaml
# operator patch
spec:
  shards:
    - id: 7
      compaction_interval: "60s"
```
Samir Patel: Confirmed rollout finished at 03:41; KV cache usage stabilized. Monitoring graphs: error_rate down to baseline.
Priya Kapoor: Noting customers impacted + mitigation notes in INC-9876. CS will email affected customers by EOD.
Maya Alvarez: Scheduling post-incident review: proposed slots: Tue 10:00 or Wed 15:00. Please vote.
Aria Chen: Tue 10 works for me.
Diego Morales: Wed 15 preferred (avoid calendar clash). But I can make Tue if needed.
Samir Patel: Wed 15 prefer.
Priya Kapoor: Tue 10 for me.
Maya Alvarez: Ok majority Tue 10. I'll book the postmortem and add agenda: timeline, root cause, actions, runbook edits, SLA/customer comms.
Aria Chen: Runbook edits to propose in PM: add a step under 'kv-cache compaction' to check operator compaction_interval <=> set to safe default, add a pre-check to reject config patches with compaction_interval < 10s. Draft:
```yaml
# runbook snippet
checks:
  - name: compaction-interval-range
    type: numeric
    min: 10
    message: "compaction_interval must be >= 10s"
```
Samir Patel: I'll own adding operator-level validation (PR -> infra repo). Expect PR by EOD with test harness.
Diego Morales: I'll add monitoring alert refinement: split `kv_cache_growth` metric into per-shard and make alert only fire if growth sustained > 5m.
Priya Kapoor: I'll draft the customer impact summary for CS and include timeline + mitigations. ETA: EOD today.
Maya Alvarez: Assigning action items summary:
- Samir: infra PR for operator validation (due: today)
- Diego: alert tuning + dashboards (due: Thu)
- Aria: runbook text + PM doc (due: Tue morning)
- Priya: customer impact writeup + notify (due: EOD)
I'll add these to the postmortem doc and ping again before handoff.
Aria Chen: One more note: consider adding an automated canary that injects compaction failure simulation into staging to avoid regressions.
Samir Patel: Good idea — planning a test harness iteration next sprint.
incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: Tue 2026-03-17 10:00 — calendar invite sent to participants.
Maya Alvarez: Thanks team. Handoff completed to me at 03:30, bridge remains open for follow-ups. Closing incident channel when postmortem doc ready.
Diego Morales: Closing tasks on ops side for immediate mitigation. Will track remaining work in the PM doc.
Aria Chen: Thanks all. :bow: End of thread.
